edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender into transferFrom as the source address.
transferFrom uses msg.sender for allowance checks and balance accounting.
approve writes allowance keyed by msg.sender.
delegate gates execution on msg.sender == owner.
_mints authorizes msg.sender against owner or a hardcoded address.
init requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale limits.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before moving balances.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
constructor assigns owner and initial balance to msg.sender.
transfer delegates all work to transferFrom.
transferFrom calls ensure to enforce the whitelist gate.
ensure calls condition for per-address sale limits.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the UNI pair address.
ensure reads the owner address for whitelist short-circuit.
ensure reads canSale[_from] to bypass condition.
ensure reads tradeAddress for whitelist bypass.
condition reads _saleNum to cap sales per address.
condition reads _minSale for the minimum amount check.
condition reads _maxSale for the maximum amount check.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf with raw += and -= outside SafeMath.
transferFrom decrements allowance with raw -= outside SafeMath.
_mints overwrites balanceOf using unchecked addedValue*10**decimals.
_mints sets canSale[spender]=true, granting whitelist bypass.
init writes the scaled minimum sale amount to _minSale.
init writes the scaled maximum sale amount to _maxSale.
init writes the permitted sale count to _saleNum.
batchSend mutates balanceOf with unchecked arithmetic.
setTradeAddress writes the whitelisted tradeAddress slot.
constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
constructor mints the whole supply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor sets an unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
constructor sets totalSupply from the scaled _supply argument.
constructor reads decimals to scale the initial supply.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall controlled by a and b.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
transferFrom performs unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
_mints computes the new balance with an unchecked multiplication.
delegatecall runs attacker code inside eMASK's storage context and can reenter the contract.
transfer passes _to onward to transferFrom.
transfer passes _value onward to transferFrom.
ensure evaluates _from against whitelist and condition.
ensure evaluates _to against the owner whitelist.
ensure forwards _value to condition.
the local _UNI pair address feeds the ensure comparison.
transferFrom debits balanceOf[_from] and allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom credits balanceOf[_to].
unvalidated _value is subtracted from balances and allowance.
approve stores the allowance for _spender.
approve stores _value as the new allowance.
condition indexes _onSaleNum by _from.
condition compares _value with the sale bounds.
attacker-influenced target address a is used as the delegatecall destination.
arbitrary calldata b is executed via delegatecall.
_mints assigns the balance and whitelist entry to spender.
addedValue is multiplied by 10**decimals without overflow protection.
init assigns saleNum to _saleNum.
init scales token into _minSale.
init scales maxToken into _maxSale.
batchSend iterates over the _tos recipient array.
_value is multiplied by _tos.length to compute the total debit.
the unchecked local total is deducted from balanceOf[msg.sender].
loop index i bounds the batchSend iteration.
each recipient _to receives an unchecked balance credit.
addr becomes the new whitelisted tradeAddress.
factory is hashed into the derived pair address.
tokenA participates in the pair ordering.
tokenB participates in the pair ordering.
pair is the computed return value of pairFor.
token0 is the ordered lower token used in the hash.
token1 is the ordered higher token used in the hash.
_name is stored in the name state variable.
_symbol is stored in the symbol state variable.
_supply is scaled into totalSupply and the owner balance.
